# Fetch liked songs (all pages) and build set of song_ids
liked_song_ids = set()
liked_songs_sample = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

    songs = None

        songs = resp
    else:

        songs = resp
    if not songs:
        break
    for s in songs:
        liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    if page_index == 0:
        liked_songs_sample = [(s['song_id'], s['title'], [a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])]) for s in songs[:5]]
    print('liked_page', page_index, 'n', len(songs), 'total_ids', len(liked_song_ids))

})

})

liked_matches = [item for item in queue_items if item['song_id'] in liked_song_ids]
M = len(liked_matches)

# Cross-check: verify these positions correspond to liked songs

    item = next((it for it in queue_items if it['position']==pos), None)
    pos_check.append((pos, item['song_id'], item['title']))

# Remove liked songs from queue at computed positions (descending to avoid index shift)
positions_to_remove = [22, 20, 19, 17, 15, 14, 13, 10, 5, 3, 0]
print('Removing count:', len(positions_to_remove))

results = []
for pos in positions_to_remove:
    try:
        r = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(position=pos, access_token=access_token)
        results.append((pos, 'ok', r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((pos, 'fail', str(e)))

print('Remove results summary:')
print('ok:', [x[0] for x in results if x[1]=='ok'])
print('fail:', [(x[0], x[2]) for x in results if x[1]=='fail'])

# Verify queue now
queue_after = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
queue_after_items = queue_after['success'] if isinstance(queue_after, dict) and 'success' in queue_after else queue_after
print('Queue after length:', len(queue_after_items))

liked_remaining = [it for it in queue_after_items if it['song_id'] in liked_song_ids]
print('Liked songs remaining in queue:', len(liked_remaining))
print('Liked remaining items:', [(it['position'], it['song_id'], it['title']) for it in liked_remaining])

# Show current song after removals
current_after = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
current_after_norm = current_after['success'] if isinstance(current_after, dict) and 'success' in current_after else current_after
print('Current after removals:', current_after_norm)
